description: DeKalb Representatives Karla Drenner, Viola Davis, Long Tran, El-Mahdi Holly, Karen Bennett, Omari Crawford, Regina Lewis-Ward, Karen Lupton, Doreen Carter, Imani Barnes, Angela Moore and Mary Margaret Oliver hosted a town hall April 30, 2025, at the Porter Sanford Performing Arts Center.
title: DeKalb legislators oppose property tax bills in Legislature
